new.statement: Young games launching with more than 8 game passes hold lower Top Trending positions among games of similar age
Solo loops earn a lower Top Earning position for their CCU than social, co-op or PvP games
Games with everyday-life roleplay mechanics rank higher on Up-and-Coming

Roblox remakes of viral indie and creator games (Something Is Wrong With My Dog, a Cuphead-style Inkhead, Poolrooms-style DONT SPLASH) reach Up-and-Coming and Top Trending within weeks, carried by an audience that already knows the original
new.action: Adapt a viral indie concept early
new.rationale: Three such games entered Up-and-Coming or Top Trending today. Confirm if more enter over the next weeks and if their positions hold beyond 3 weeks; a 'remake/inspired by' description flag would let the scan test it.

qualitative_updates.note: Apple iPad Original fell off Most Popular today, while Fix My Phone! (+44) and Realistic Phone Drop Test (new on Most Popular) are rising; the curiosity-only device game faded as predicted, but the ones with a real job or physics loop are holding.
Mixed: Fake an Egg entered Most Popular and Bike For Egg rose +21, against the fading-wave claim; Steal A Baddie Egg (-79 Top Earning) and Shoot For Eggs (-74) fit it.
Transition counts kept the same order: tt→mp 82 (2d), uc→tt 80 (2d), uc→te 51, uc→mp 47; tt→uc is still 1.
